messages:
miguel_support: Heads-up — Support escalated StratusMed (trial, 250 seats) — onboarding flow broken, users stuck on verification step. Renewal in 3 weeks, account flagged as at-risk. Ticket SUP-5721.

sara_csm: Ack. Can you paste the short bug summary + repro? I want to draft a comms plan for the CSM owner and renewals team. @olga_enablement any immediate enablement to reduce churn risk? :eyes:

miguel_support: Short version: embedding ingestion fails intermittently for their S3 bucket size (~12GB). Error seen in prod agent: `kv_store: timeout after 12s` then 502 back to client. Repro: upload dataset -> start ingest -> progress reaches ~60% then fails. Logs attached in ticket.

james_engineer: Looking. Tentative root cause: batching change in last runtime release + their object layout triggers excessive head requests. I can try a hotfix to limit concurrency for that customer. Will need a deploy and config rollback window.

olga_enablement: For momentum: we can run a targeted onboarding webinar to keep key users engaged while eng works the fix. Suggest 45m session, share workaround (small batch uploads, single file splits). I can run one today at 3pm PT if we confirm invite list.

sara_csm: Good. Plan draft: 1) Immediate: enable manual retry & temp quota bump so current trial users can finish (ops). 2) Today 15:00 PT: enablement webinar with product walkthrough + workaround. 3) Engineering hotfix roll (james) with canary for StratusMed, fallback to old batching if issues. 4) Post-fix: 1:1 success review with customer + renewal risk update. Who owns each?

miguel_support: Ops owner: @miguel_support will open priority ops request for retry flow and temp bump (SUP-5722). Webinar owner: @olga_enablement. Eng owner: @james_engineer for hotfix. CSM lead: @sara_csm.

james_engineer: Timeline: can build + QA in 4 hours, need deploy window ~1h. Canary to 5% traffic for 30m. If green, ramp to 100%. If fail, automatic rollback. I’ll post deploy plan in SUP-5721.

incident-bot: Deploy window requested by james_engineer scheduled for 20:30 UTC (tags: hotfix, canary).

sara_csm: Comms to customer: send a note now acknowledging escalation + our timeline (webinar today, fix ETA tonight). I'll draft and post to the ticket; please review. Also copying renewals: renewals@redwood-inference to pause auto-renew outreach until we mark risk mitigated.

olga_enablement: Webinar slides ready (short deck + live demo). Send me list of emails and I’ll set up Zoom and run deck. Also prep a one-page workaround doc we can attach to ticket.

miguel_support: Added support logs + S3 object manifest to SUP-5721. Ops request created SUP-5722 for quota bump.

james_engineer: I pushed a config bypass to canary branch; will wait for the ops bump to start end-to-end test.

sara_csm: Thanks all. I'll send the customer note now and ping renewals. After the webinar we should have a clear signal on adoption. I’ll update thread with customer sentiment. :thumbsup:

miguel_support: Customer replied in-ticket: "Appreciate the quick turnaround — available for webinar 3pm PT."

olga_enablement: Invite sent. Webinar 15:00 PT. I’ll record and share notes.

sara_csm: Closing next steps checklist: 1) ops bump (SUP-5722) — miguel 2) webinar 15:00 PT — olga 3) eng canary deploy 20:30 UTC — james 4) customer follow-up + renewals hold — sara. If anything slips, escalate to directors.

miguel_support: Will update SUP-5721/SUP-5722 with status changes.

sara_csm: End-state goal: move StratusMed from At-Risk -> Stabilized before renewal outreach. Keep this thread for comms. Thanks team.
